# Flipgold 6.0 design

Coins scatter in a continuous plane, jump for 540–670 ms, and choose a separated random landing. Tools use physical distance, strips, fans and ripples.

Progression: 24 polish levels, 15 animal levels, 8 ranks per owned tool. Region and mission requirements gate later ranks. Clock repairs have three stages; repairing unlocks the river.

Collection: 31 types, 30 generated embossed special faces. Regional fragments require 3/6/10/16 to restore, hidden coins require 18. Fragment floor at 300 successful flips; available regional legendary fragment floor at 40 regional fragment finds. Region clears 2/4/8 unlock rarity bands. Cleared regions offer repeatable free patrols.

Old saves are accepted without growth metadata and migrated lazily without resetting wealth, tools, coins, story or routes. New metadata is validated. Existing test scripts remain unchanged. Visual preview workflow only.
